cover.caption: Askeladden møter trollet i skogen, og han er ikke det minste redd.
cover.alt: Et digert troll med brun hud og svart, bustete hår står mellom grantrærne og kikker ned. På en mosegrodd stein står Askeladden og smiler opp til ham.
cover.prompt: A wide view of a misty autumn forest: the Troll stands among the tall spruces and rust-red birches, so big that his shaggy head pokes up between the treetops, and bends forward to peer down curiously at little Askeladden. Askeladden stands on a mossy boulder at his feet with his small sack over his shoulder, grinning up at him without a trace of fear. Orange leaves drift through the grey mist.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Den yngste sønnen, rolig og smart, som møter utfordringer med oppfinnsomhet og en vennlig selvsikkerhet.
characters.look: A small, wiry boy of about eleven, shorter than most boys his age, with a round face, rosy cheeks, bright brown eyes, a button nose, a dark-brown curly mop of hair and a cheeky gap-toothed grin. He wears a moss-green knitted jumper with brown leather elbow patches, dark-brown knee breeches, thick oatmeal-coloured wool stockings and scuffed brown boots. A small brown linen sack with a drawstring hangs from his shoulder.

characters.name: Trollet
characters.description: Skogens store vokter som først virker streng, men lar seg lett imponere og blir mer komisk enn farlig.
characters.look: A giant forest troll, so tall that his head pokes up among the treetops, with cracked, bark-brown skin like an old pine trunk, a shaggy black haystack of hair full of twigs and dry leaves, a potato nose, small twinkly yellow eyes, an enormous mouth that stretches from ear to ear with big square teeth, long dangling arms and a huge, round belly. He wears baggy, patched sackcloth trousers held up by braces of twisted roots, and no shirt.

characters.name: Faren
characters.description: En gammel og sliten bonde som ønsker at sønnene skal arbeide så familien kan klare seg bedre.
characters.look: A short, stocky, bow-legged old farmer of about seventy with a broad, weather-beaten, wrinkled face, a big bulbous nose, small twinkling eyes under shaggy grey eyebrows and a thick, bristly grey beard cut short and square. He wears a battered, wide-brimmed black felt hat, a patched grey-blue wool jacket with horn buttons over a collarless linen shirt, brown knee breeches with braces, grey wool stockings and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Den eldste broren
characters.description: Askeladdens eldste bror, stor og sterk, men så redd for trollet at øksa glipper og han springer hjem.
characters.look: A hulking, broad-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a thick neck, a broad, flat face, a crooked nose, small pale-blue eyes, heavy black eyebrows and short, bristly black hair cropped close to his head. He wears a shaggy, sleeveless sheepskin vest over a rough grey homespun shirt, baggy brown trousers tied under the knees with leather laces, and heavy black boots.

characters.name: Den mellomste broren
characters.description: Askeladdens mellomste bror, som springer så fort fra trollet at lua blir hengende igjen på en grein.
characters.look: A thin, jittery young man of about sixteen with a long neck, a narrow face, a long pointed nose, big worried eyes and frizzy light-brown hair. On his head sits a long, floppy, bright-yellow knitted stocking cap with a blue tassel. He wears a baggy blue linen smock belted with a cord, patched grey trousers and wooden clogs.

places.name: the Troll's Hall
places.look: A big, high room hollowed out of the rock inside the mountain, with rough brown rock walls and thick tree roots poking through the ceiling. A wide stone fireplace glows at one end, with a huge black iron pot hanging over the fire. A long, rough plank table with one long bench stands in front of it, two giant iron buckets stand by a heavy round wooden door, and everything is troll-sized, big and chunky.

illustrations.anchor: «... var du aldri redd for troll», sa brødrene i kor.
illustrations.caption: «... var du aldri redd for troll», sier brødrene i kor. «Vi vet det.»
illustrations.alt: Faren står midt i stua med fingeren i været. På benken sitter de to storebrødrene og himler med øynene, og ved peisen sitter Askeladden og smiler.
